title: Axis-Marker Reflection Completion
written_solution: The cyan(8) markers identify a reflection axis without drawing the whole line. Infer whether that axis is vertical or horizontal from the markers, then mirror the existing colored cells across it to complete the reflected figure.
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (let* ((axis (find-color g 8)) (axis-cols (remove-duplicates (map second axis))) (axis-rows (remove-duplicates (map first axis)))) (if (= (length axis-cols) 1) (let ((b (first axis-cols))) (for*/fold ((out g)) ((r (in-range (rows g))) (c (in-range (cols g)))) (let ((v (at g r c)) (mc (- (* 2 b) c))) (if (and (not (member? v (list 0 8))) (in-bounds? r mc (rows g) (cols g)) (= (at out r mc) 0)) (set-cell out r mc v) out)))) (let ((b (first axis-rows))) (for*/fold ((out g)) ((r (in-range (rows g))) (c (in-range (cols g)))) (let ((v (at g r c)) (mr (- (* 2 b) r))) (if (and (not (member? v (list 0 8))) (in-bounds? mr c (rows g) (cols g)) (= (at out mr c) 0)) (set-cell out mr c v) out))))))))
